candidates.hypothesis: Change in option market makers' net SPX option position (signed high-frequency SPX trades) predicts the end-of-day S&P 500 futures return
candidates.mechanism: market-maker delta hedging of gamma plus inventory changes (Egebjerg-Kokholm model)
candidates.entry_window_ct: not published (end of day; seminar abstract only)
candidates.best_source: Egebjerg and Kokholm, A Model for the Hedging Impact of Option Market Makers, SSRN 4936978 (2024); Aarhus seminar abstract
candidates.quote: we estimate changes to the net option position of OMMs over an extended period and find that the change is a strong predictor of the end-of-day return on SPX futures
candidates.data_needed: signed SPX option trades by participant type (Cboe Open-Close or equivalent), intraday
candidates.data_cost: not read here (R2 owns Cboe/OPRA pricing)
candidates.why: unsized; data not owned; listed as a pointer for the lead
candidates.prop_notes: one trade a day before the 15:00 CT close; real-time signed data needed
candidates.overlap_note: same end-of-day window; signal is signed market-maker position change, not price momentum or GEX sign

evidence.quote: We have verified the computations of SqueezeMetrics using OptionMetrics data over the 2002 to 2017 period, yielding virtually identical results.
In the period from 1996 until May 2020 there have been 2930 days with a negative NGE and 3158 with a positive one.
The last two columns confirm that these results are not driven by a time trend shared by intraday momentum and NGE by running a difference-in-difference regression.

evidence.claim: GEX sign convention (calls long, puts short for MMs)
evidence.quote: 2. Call options are sold by investors; bought by market-makers. ... 3. Put options are bought by investors; sold by market-makers.
evidence.source: SqueezeMetrics, Gamma Exposure white paper, Dec 2017

evidence.quote: When instead we compare the highest and second-highest** quartiles of GEX to subsequent SPX variance, the 1-day standard deviations are 0.55% and 0.85%, respectively.

The economic magnitude of the result, however, is limited. A unitary standard deviation increase in the gamma imbalance proxy is associated to a decrease in autocorrelation of about 1% of a standard deviation.
evidence.source: Barbon and Buraschi, Gamma Fragility, SoF HSG WP 2020

evidence.quote: one standard deviation increase in the gamma imbalance is associated to a decrease in absolute return of the underlying index of more than 20 basis points (about 20% of a standard deviation)

evidence.claim: Signed measure: MM net gamma mostly positive
evidence.number: 88% of 10-min intervals; monthly mean always positive
evidence.quote: Figure IA2 shows that Net Γt is positive for 88 percent of all 10-minute trading intervals. ... Summing 0DTE and non-0DTE exposures, we find that the monthly average is always positive.
evidence.source: Adams, Dim, Eraker, Fontaine, Ornthanalai, Vilkov, draft 2026-07-15 (R1 owns)

evidence.claim: Signed-measure conditional momentum small, not tradable
evidence.quote: they increase monotonically from almost zero in the next 10-minute interval to around 0.7 bps at the 1- and 2-hour horizons. ... this result does not translate into a feasible trading strategy since the market makers' net gamma is not observable to other investors.

evidence.claim: NGE assumption introduces measurement error (authors' later work)
evidence.quote: The above N GE measure relies on the assumption that market makers are short the entire put and long the entire call open interest at each point in time (see Baltussen et al. (2021)), which introduces measurement errors.
evidence.source: Baltussen, Da, Soebhag, End-of-Day Reversal, WP Apr 2025

evidence.claim: Market-level TS momentum in stock decomposition
evidence.quote: Further, we show the expected profit of the TS strategy, which is 2.79 basis points per day, in line with intraday momentum at the market-level.

evidence.claim: Signed MM position change predicts SPX futures EOD return (unsized)
evidence.quote: we estimate changes to the net option position of OMMs over an extended period and find that the change is a strong predictor of the end-of-day return on SPX futures

evidence.claim: FX dealer gamma reconstructed from trade repository is negative
evidence.quote: we first reconstruct the aggregated OMM's gamma exposure by using trade repository data and find that it is negative
